summary: [spec fidelity] a negative 64-bit value written with a space (`--max-artifact-mib -9007199254740992`, `--limit -1`) is exit 2 USAGE but its `field` is the token clap reads as a flag (`-9`, `-1`), not the option (spec 7.1.1, brief F5 says the field is the argument); the `--opt=-N` form that scenario 11 and its test use names the option correctly; also `-0` is refused by the u64 options (`--interval-secs -0`, `retrieve --limit -0`) though it is in the declared domain and matches the contract's integer grammar; blast radius: every integer option, argv only
